properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Origins permitted to call the /api/** endpoints via CORS. Bound in WebConfig; defaults to http://localhost:5173 when unset.

properties.name: app.security.csrf.enabled
properties.description: Whether CSRF protection is enforced. Bound in SecurityConfig; enabled by default and disabled in the test profile.

properties.name: app.bootstrap.admin.email
properties.description: Email for the first-boot ADMIN account. Bound in BootstrapAdminSeeder; the admin is created only when this and app.bootstrap.admin.password are set and the users table is empty.

properties.name: app.bootstrap.admin.password
properties.description: Raw password for the first-boot ADMIN account (BCrypt-hashed before storage). Bound in BootstrapAdminSeeder; supply via APP_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD at runtime and remove after first login.
